title: 臀部轻轻抬
description: 成人仰卧屈膝，脚掌落地，做舒适的低幅臀桥。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult lies on a mat with both feet planted near the hips and knees pointing naturally forward. Capture a modest glute bridge, pelvis lifted without arching the lower back, shoulders and head supported, arms resting along the mat. A side profile makes the hip position legible and avoids overlapping knees. Let a nearby window cast soft rectangular light onto the empty floor, turning a basic exercise into a calm everyday scene. Use a painterly oil-pastel illustration with broken strokes, strong volume, a dusty pink and petrol-blue palette, and inviting natural light. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels.
